prompt:

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. base_prompt: A person wants to read more but repeatedly abandons very ambitious reading schedules. Propose a small routine that still works during a busy week. Keep your response near 120 words.
text: Try reading for five minutes after something you already do each day, such as brushing your teeth or making evening tea. Keep one appealing book beside that spot so starting takes almost no effort. On especially busy days, read just one paragraph; that counts as keeping the routine, not failing it. You can continue when you feel interested, but avoid increasing your daily minimum after a good week. If you miss a day, simply return at the next opportunity without catching up. Choose books you genuinely want to read, and give yourself permission to abandon ones you dislike. The aim is to make reading an easy, pleasant part of ordinary life rather than another demanding schedule to maintain.
